# Putnam Lead Group

> Putnam Lead Group (PLG) is a veteran-owned local marketing business in Palatka, Putnam County, Florida, run by Kyle Simmons, a Marine Corps veteran. It helps local service businesses such as lawn care, HVAC, plumbing, roofing and other contractors get found on Google, Apple Maps, Bing and AI search tools, earn real reviews, and reply to new leads fast.

## Key facts

- Business: Putnam Lead Group LLC, veteran-owned
- Founder: Kyle Simmons, Marine Corps veteran, lives in the Palatka area
- Service area: Palatka and all of Putnam County, Florida, including East Palatka, Crescent City, Interlachen, Welaka, Pomona Park, San Mateo, Satsuma, Hollister, Florahome, Putnam Hall, Georgetown, Bostwick, Lake Como, Melrose
- Who it serves: local service businesses, including lawn care and landscaping, HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, pressure washing, pest control, tree service, fencing, metal fabrication
- Phone (call or text): (386) 227-7496
- Email: hello@putnamleads.com
- Book a free 15-minute call: https://calendar.app.google/a9EtzHDwfKSSUBdz9
- Website: https://putnamleads.com/

## Pricing

- One-time cleanup: $299. Google Business Profile setup or cleanup, Apple Maps, Bing and Yelp listings, Facebook page details matched, matching name, phone and website on the main directories, a one-tap Google review link and a short ask the owner texts customers, help recovering a lost Google profile, and website wording fixes if the business has a site. One location.
- Keep It Fresh monthly plan: $175 a month, month to month, stop with 30 days' written notice. A Google post every week, job photos added, every review answered, holiday hours handled and a plain-English monthly report. Founding 6: the first 6 monthly clients keep $175 a month for as long as they stay.
- Follow-up automations such as missed-call text-back are not part of the posted plans yet. PLG does not send texts to a client's customers.
- Not included: new website builds, paid ads, paid tools, or any promise of rankings or lead counts.

## How PLG works

- Clients deal with Kyle Simmons directly, no call centers.
- Real reviews only. PLG never writes, buys, fakes or incentivizes reviews.
- PLG does not promise Google rankings or AI recommendations.
- Client accounts stay in the client's name; PLG works as a removable manager.
